name: Guangdong Shunkong Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Shunkong Development Co.,Ltd. engages in the production and sale of tap water in China. It offers wastewater treatment and reuse, waste incineration power generation, packaging and printing, municipal engineering and environmental protection, engineering projects, BOT project operation, and installation engineering services. The company is also involved in construction engineering work, waste incineration project operation, urban sewage treatment, environmental governance, new energy equipment, energy conservation business, construction project, and environmental monitoring and consulting services.
